scope: Three family-level decisions after examining spaced samples and every stored evidence class; original member lists locked by digest. No claim of individual lexical annotation.

decisions.reason: The German -chen string is a diminutive suffix across unrelated nouns (Eulchen, Körperchen, Kügelchen), and also occurs in unrelated verb endings (coachen, schlichen) and compound/place names. A suffix match does not establish whole-lemma ancestry. The safe_automatic status was not supported by any checked etymology in these memberships.

The English final -ted includes unrelated participles such as dominated, protonated and exploited and hyphenated phrases such as media-related, along with corpus noise. It is not a common lexical root.
Spanish -ela joins pronouns to otherwise unrelated verbs (colocársela, mandándosela, recógertela) and also matches incidental final letters. It is not a shared whole-lemma etymon.

review_scope: Remove incoherent surface groups without deleting the source words or their other memberships. The linguistic status of the remaining homographic aliases is outside this decision.
